title: Generate a temporary inbox and see it become active
description: This verifies that a guest user can create a disposable inbox and immediately see the generated address and active expiration timer.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the generate new email action
Verify a temporary email address is displayed
Verify an active expiration timer is displayed

title: Create a temporary inbox on the main dashboard
description: This verifies that a guest can generate a disposable email address and see an active inbox ready for use.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Verify an active email account is displayed
Verify the inbox is ready to receive messages

title: Read a newly received message in the live inbox
description: This verifies that an incoming email appears in the live inbox and can be opened for reading.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Wait for a new incoming email to appear
Open the message
Verify the message content is displayed
Verify the inbox shows the new unread mail state cleared

title: See incoming mail appear in the live inbox
description: This verifies that a user can observe new incoming messages appearing in the live inbox for the active temporary address.
category: Real-Time Live Inbox and Message Reader

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the generate new email action
Wait for a new message to appear
Verify incoming messages are displayed in the inbox
Verify the new message is visible in the message list

title: Open and read a received message
description: This verifies that a user can select an incoming email and read its full content in the message reader pane.
category: Real-Time Live Inbox and Message Reader

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the generate new email action
Wait for a new message to appear
Open the message
Verify the message reader pane is displayed
Verify the message content is visible

title: Extract an OTP or verification link from a message
description: This verifies that a user can open a message and use the built-in one-click action to copy an OTP or open a verification link.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Wait for a new incoming email to appear
Open the message
Use the OTP or verification link action
Verify the OTP or verification link action is available
Verify the message remains open for review

title: Extract and copy an OTP from a message
description: This verifies that a user can open a message containing a one-time passcode and copy the detected OTP for use elsewhere.
category: Smart OTP and Verification Link Extractor

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the generate new email action
Wait for a message containing an OTP to appear
Copy the detected OTP code
Verify a copy confirmation is visible
Verify the OTP is available in the message actions

title: Open a verification link from an email
description: This verifies that a user can open a detected verification link directly from a received message.
category: Smart OTP and Verification Link Extractor

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the generate new email action
Wait for a message containing a verification link to appear
Open the verification link from the message
Verify the verification link action is available
Verify the link is opened for confirmation

title: Create a custom inbox with username, domain, and lifespan
description: This verifies that a guest user can create a disposable inbox using custom address settings and see the resulting inbox details.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Enter a custom username
Select a custom domain
Select a lifespan duration
Create the email address
Verify the custom temporary email address is displayed
Verify the selected lifespan is reflected in the inbox timer

title: Switch between multiple active inboxes
description: This verifies that a user can view multiple active email accounts and switch the active inbox without leaving the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Create another temporary inbox
Switch to the other active inbox
Verify the active inbox changes to a different email account
Verify messages for the selected inbox are shown

title: Copy the generated email address
description: This verifies that a guest user can copy a newly generated disposable email address for use elsewhere.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the generate new email action
Copy the email address
Verify a copy confirmation is visible
Verify the generated email address remains displayed

title: Extend an inbox lifespan by ten minutes
description: This verifies that a user can extend an active account and see the expiration timer update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Extend the inbox lifespan by ten minutes
Verify the expiration timer is updated
Verify the inbox remains active

title: Switch between rich and raw message views
description: This verifies that a user can toggle the same email between formatted HTML and plain-text views and see the content update.
category: Real-Time Live Inbox and Message Reader

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the generate new email action
Wait for a new message to appear
Open the message
Switch to the other message view
Verify the message content is displayed in the selected view
Verify the alternate view is no longer shown

title: Keep multiple inboxes active and switch between them
description: This verifies that a power user can create more than one disposable inbox, switch the active account, and keep each address available.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the generate new email action
Create another email address
Switch to the other active inbox
Verify the active email address changes
Verify multiple active inboxes are available

title: Delete an active inbox
description: This verifies that a user can remove an active disposable account from the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Delete the active inbox
Verify the active inbox is removed
Verify an empty or replacement state is shown

title: Delete a message from the inbox
description: This verifies that a user can remove an email from the live inbox and see it disappear from the message list.
category: Real-Time Live Inbox and Message Reader

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the generate new email action
Wait for a new message to appear
Delete the message
Verify the message is removed from the inbox
Verify the deleted message is no longer available to open

title: Preview an attachment safely in the browser
description: This verifies that a user can open an attached file in the secure preview modal and inspect it without leaving the app.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Wait for a message with an attachment to appear
Open the message
Open the safe preview for the attachment
Verify the attachment preview modal is displayed
Verify the attachment content is visible in the preview

title: Sign in and open the synced vault
description: A signed-in user can authenticate and access the permanent vault and history view.
category: Google Authentication and Permanent Cloud Vault

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the sign in with Google control
Complete sign in with Google
Open the saved vault and history view
Verify saved messages are displayed
Verify past addresses are displayed

title: Review synced saved messages and addresses
description: A signed-in user can open the vault and review both saved messages and past addresses.
category: Google Authentication and Permanent Cloud Vault

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the sign in with Google control
Complete sign in with Google
Open the saved vault and history view
Verify saved messages are displayed
Verify past addresses are displayed

title: Sign out of the permanent vault
description: A signed-in user can sign out and return to the guest experience.
category: Google Authentication and Permanent Cloud Vault

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the sign in with Google control
Complete sign in with Google
Click the sign out control
Verify the guest experience is displayed
Verify the vault view is no longer displayed

title: Download an attachment from the safe preview
description: This verifies that a user can start downloading an attachment after opening the secure preview.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Wait for a message with an attachment to appear
Open the message
Open the safe preview for the attachment
Download the attachment
Verify the attachment download action is available
Verify the preview remains accessible after the action

title: Toggle between light and dark appearance
description: A guest user can switch the app theme and see the appearance update.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the theme setting
Verify the interface switches to the alternate appearance mode

title: Mute and re-enable sound notifications for new mail
description: This verifies that the user can turn notification sounds off and back on while staying on the inbox screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Mute sound notifications
Wait for a new incoming email to appear
Enable sound notifications
Verify the sound notification control reflects the enabled state
Verify incoming mail still appears in the inbox

title: Switch the interface language
description: A guest user can choose a different language and see the interface update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the language selector
Choose a supported language
Verify the interface is displayed in the selected language

title: Change language and theme together
description: A guest user can update both language and appearance settings without leaving the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the language selector
Choose a supported language
Toggle the theme setting
Verify the selected language remains applied
Verify the alternate appearance mode is active

title: Close a safe attachment preview with Escape
description: This verifies that a user can dismiss the attachment sandbox modal using the keyboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a temporary inbox
Wait for a message with an attachment to appear
Open the message
Open the safe preview for the attachment
Press Escape
Verify the attachment preview modal is dismissed
Verify the underlying message remains open
